title: Parse ISO week strings with a readable pattern
task: Write `ParseISOWeek(text string) (year int, week int, err error)` in package `isoweek` accepting `2024-W07` (four-digit year, a literal W, two-digit week 01 to 53). Use a regular expression, and make it possible for a reader to understand the pattern without decoding it by hand. Reject `2024-W54`, `2024-W7`, and `2024W07` with an error that quotes the input. Test the accepted form and each rejection.
